entries.english: Furthermore, Johann von Brunn, Bischof, borrowed another 200 florins from Anselm von Rosenberg, who had by then become a Ritter, and added that sum to the previous 6,000 florins. No bond survives for this. Under this arrangement, in 1437 Johann von Brunn, Bischof, pledged Peter von Stettenberg 80 florins annually on the rent from Prosselsheim. Liber contractuum Brun, fol. 199.

facts.content: lent Bishop Johann von Brunn a further 200 florins, which were added to the earlier 6,000-florin sum.
